narrative.overview: Quiet mobile-derived grouped lists, restrained borders and direct playback controls. The landing player remains a demo; Library uses real account metadata, catalog search reaches Spotify songs, and the separate Spotify pilot offers opt-in experimental foreground whole-lyric-line skipping. Surface badges distinguish DEMO, SPOTIFY, UNFILTERED, LINE SKIP and STOPPED. Track identity and transport precede artwork and secondary navigation on the live player. Only metadata reaches the lyric provider; no Spotify audio is captured or analyzed. Real LRCLIB data and simulated SDK tests do not establish audible timing or background protection. No new creative metaphor or theme tokens were assigned.
keyCharacteristics: Fictional geometric demo artwork; Spotify cover imagery in Library
dos: Do preserve paired semantic theme roles.
Do keep source/filtering status and keyboard focus visible.
donts: Do not generalize artwork palettes into UI tokens.
Do not imply verified protection or validated background filtering.
